requirements.statement: Enumerate assigned Nikon D810 cameras and distinguish them as CAM-A and CAM-B using local stable identity.
acceptance_evidence: Redacted Phase 0 inventory and reconnect report

requirements.statement: Persist left/right assignment independent of connection order and USB port while keeping real identity local.
Capture and download CAM-A, close its session, then capture and download CAM-B as one operator transaction.
Accept only the unique new JPEG after each active-session baseline into the sole unfinished transaction.
acceptance_evidence: Ambiguous and late image rejection tests

requirements.statement: Open at most one Nikon SDK camera session and execute exclusive CAM-A to CAM-B sequential control.
On timeout, disconnect, partial capture, or ambiguity, retain available files and diagnostics, do not auto-retry, and finish FailedPartial.
Store per-camera lens calibration parameters.

requirements.statement: Store fixed planar transform, overlap, seam, and crop settings for a rig.

requirements.statement: Apply the fixed transform and only bounded residual alignment at runtime.

requirements.statement: Compensate exposure and color differences and blend the seam.
source_refs: docs/PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md#キャリブレーションと合成

requirements.statement: Return warning and quality metrics when a stitch is outside accepted thresholds.

requirements.statement: Retain every successfully recovered original JPEG after successful or failed transactions.
Record transaction state, camera alias, timestamps, file size, SHA-256, result, and error metadata.
Export a stitched JPEG to the selected local folder.
Show both camera states, rig profile, progress, result, and warnings.
Provide capture, restitch, output-folder, and settings operations.
Run on Windows 11 x64; Phase 0 uses C++20/CMake and M3 adds .NET 10.
Provisional p95 from capture start to stitched JPEG completion is 10 seconds; Phase 0 timing is measurement-only.
acceptance_evidence: Phase 0 timing report and M2 end-to-end benchmark

requirements.statement: Phase 0B requires 100 of 100 first-attempt paired transactions with no capture or recovery failure, mispair, original loss, ambiguous auto-adoption, or unrecoverable stop.
Record session, command, image detection, download, atomic persistence, stitch, and error timestamps.
Keep images local, perform no MVP cloud upload, and exclude real identifiers and SDK material from commits.
Measure peak memory on minimum 16 GB and recommended 32 GB PCs before setting a product limit.
Use two Nikon D810 cameras over USB.
Do not add hardware shutter synchronization or guarantee actual shutter-opening skew.
Prefer Nikon D810 Camera Remote SDK with exclusive sequential sessions; require product-owner approval before WPD fallback work.
Do not commit Nikon SDK material or real camera identity; approve internal evaluation and product redistribution separately.

requirements.statement: Exclude moving subjects, handheld operation, near-field 3D subjects, and real-time video.

out_of_scope: automatic retry of a failed transaction
